text: DSH Agent 工作室是面向 DSH Web 的可视化 Agent 配置插件，通过侧栏工作台连接宿主模型、工具和 Skills。用户可以按插件选择工具能力、编辑系统提示词与消息、试运行并查看历史，还能将配置保存为 Agent Preset 或通过内置创建助手逐步生成 Agent。适合需要在 DSH Web 中搭建、调整和验证专用 Agent 的用户。插件不配置模型密钥，模型与凭据由 DSH 宿主提供；试运行的提示和上下文会发给所选模型。

DSH Agent Studio is a visual Agent editor for DSH Web. Configure plugin tools and Skills, edit prompts, run trials, review history, and save presets. Its built-in creator helps draft and test Agents. Models and credentials come from DSH; trial prompts and context go to the selected model.
想在 DSH Web 里用界面配置自己的 Agent。

有没有办法先试跑 Agent，再修改工具结果继续对话？
想通过对话逐步创建、检查并保存一个新 Agent。
I want to configure and save task-specific Agents in the DSH web interface.
Can I test an Agent with sample tasks before saving it?
DSH Agent 工作室的功能「按插件选择能力」：工作台展示当前可用的插件工具与 Skills，用户可按插件启用全部工具或选择具体工具，再保存到 Agent 配置。
DSH Agent 工作室的功能「试运行与结果编辑」：用户输入消息后运行 Agent，查看模型回复和工具调用；可手动执行工具、编辑工具结果后继续运行，并从历史中查看已保存的运行记录。
DSH Agent 工作室的功能「对话创建 Agent」：内置 Agent 创建助手读取模型、插件工具和 Skills 目录，检查草稿并生成系统提示词；用户确认能力和提示词后可用示例任务试跑，再保存为工作室 Agent。
DSH Agent 工作室使用 DSH 宿主提供的模型；运行时会把用户消息、系统提示词及运行上下文发送给所选模型服务。模型凭据由宿主配置，插件自身没有固定密钥字段。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · DSH Agent Studio：Build and test Agents visually in DeepSeek Harness Web: bind tools by plugin, edit tool results during trials, preserve session capability snapshots, and export standalone presets. A guided Agent Creator preset helps draft new Agents in conversation.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#install) · [Downloads](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：Requires **Node.js 24+** and **DSH Web 0.1.7-rc.2 or 0.2.0-rc.2**. Stop the target Web profile, then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-1.13.3.tgz
dsh web
```

The command above installs the prebuilt GitHub Release. When this version is available on npm, you can also install `dsh-workbench-agent-studio@1.13.3` by package name.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：Use the same `DSH_HOME` for installation and startup. The application archive includes its service, UI and runtime components; navigation, themes and Library are optional and are not installed by Studio.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：You can also download the prebuilt `.tgz` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) and pass its path to `dsh plugin --profile web add`. Installing a GitHub source checkout is not equivalent: compiled `dist/` files are intentionally not committed.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：**Version scope:** Studio **1.13.3**, portable runtime **1.10.5**. Only the two exact DSH versions above are declared compatible. `0.2.1-alpha.5` removes the `both` tool mode and changes PTC behavior; it is not supported by this release. Official macOS Apple Silicon Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 has also passed the [additional desktop checks](docs/compatibility.md); other desktop builds remain unverified. Desktop installation uses its bundled CLI and `--profile desktop`, not the Web profile.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Configure, try, revise：1. Open **Agent Studio** in the sidebar. Create an Agent or copy a built-in preset.
2. Choose a chat model, instructions, plugin tools and Skills. Choose all current tools from a plugin or an explicit subset.
3. Trial-run a message. Run tools manually or automatically, edit their results, then continue or rerun. Previous runs remain available in history.
4. Start a normal conversation with the saved Agent, or export its preset for another installation.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Configure, try, revise：Tool ownership follows the actual host registrations. At session start, Studio stores the effective tool set and plugin identities. Existing sessions and historical retries keep their recorded scope; plugin removal or changed ownership is reported rather than silently granting a replacement tool.

Screenshots use an isolated DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 instance, synthetic data and a local scripted model. They illustrate the interface, not the quality of an external model's answers.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Guided Agent Creator：Choose **Agent 创建助手 / Agent Creator** before starting a conversation. It collects requirements, selects available capabilities, drafts instructions, checks the draft, offers a trial, and saves only after confirmation. Creator tools are scoped to this preset; they are not added to standard mode or unrelated Agents. Creator trials execute read-only tools and record other calls without executing them. Unsaved drafts do not appear in the Studio Agent list.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · What this plugin changes：Studio **disables the official `tools` configuration row** and installs a `ToolRuntime` subclass that records plugin ownership. Tool execution, schema validation, permissions and scope enforcement remain in the official superclass. The original row's configuration is inherited. It also mounts a capability snapshot service and registers saved Agents as presets.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · What this plugin changes：**Other plugins that replace the tool provider or rewrite the same tool layer can conflict.** Check the combined configuration before using them together. Restart the profile after installation, removal or tool-provider configuration changes. Removing the Studio bundle restores the official provider unless another user patch disables it.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：Studio uses official storage domains under the host's configured storage backend (by default **`$DSH_HOME/storages`**):

| Domain | Stored data |
|---|---|
| `workbench_agent_studio` | Agents, revisions, trials, evaluations, tool receipts and prompt drafts |
| `workbench_agent_studio_capabilities` | Session capability snapshots |
| `workbench_agent_studio_library_migrations` | Explicit compatibility-migration receipts; Library is optional |

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：The default working directory is `$DSH_HOME/workbench-agent-studio/workspace`. Models, credentials and tool providers come from your host. Trial content is sent to the model you select; selected tools act with their host permissions.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-agent-studio
```

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：Restart the profile after removal. The Studio UI/API are removed; saved data are retained and become available after reinstallation. Removing Studio does not delete user files or sessions. Exported presets still need the standalone runtime below.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Run an exported preset elsewhere：Install the **portable runtime**, the exported Agent's actual tool plugins, and configure its model in the destination host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-runtime-1.10.5.tgz
dsh web --patch /path/to/exported-agent.yml
```

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Run an exported preset elsewhere：The export includes the host-level tool registry and snapshot service plus the preset declaration. Do not mount another snapshot service inside every Agent. The destination does not need Studio Service or UI. Remove exported preset patches before removing their runtime.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Development and verification：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build
npm run check
npm test

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Development and verification：`check` checks JavaScript syntax, not full TypeScript types. The host suites were run against official 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2. Clean Web validation covered plugin binding, a real file-tool call, edited tool results, history, runtime-only preset import, removal and reinstall with data preserved. Scripted-model and in-memory-DOM tests do not establish external-model quality or every desktop/browser configuration.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · DSH Agent 工作室：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中可视化配置和试跑 Agent：按插件绑定工具、编辑工具结果后继续运行、保存会话能力快照，并导出可独立运行的 Preset。内置“Agent 创建助手”可通过对话逐步生成新 Agent。

[English](README.md) · [安装包下载](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 安装：需要 **Node.js 24+**，以及官方 **DSH Web 0.1.7-rc.2 或 0.2.0-rc.2**。停止目标 Web Profile 后执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-1.13.3.tgz
dsh web
```

上面的命令直接安装 GitHub Release 产物。本版出现在 npm 后，也可按包名 `dsh-workbench-agent-studio@1.13.3` 安装。

安装和启动使用相同的 `DSH_HOME`。完整包内含 Service、UI 和 Runtime；不依赖导航、主题、资料库或文档插件。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 安装：也可从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) 下载预构建 `.tgz`，将文件路径传给 `dsh plugin --profile web add`。GitHub 源码不含 `dist/`，不能把源码下载当作现成安装包。

本版为 **工作室 1.13.3 / runtime 1.10.5**，只声明上述两个精确宿主版本。**不支持 0.2.1-alpha.5**：该版移除了工具 `both` 模式，PTC 行为也有变化。已补充验证官方 macOS Apple Silicon 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2，其他桌面版本仍未验证。桌面安装须使用自带 CLI 和 `--profile desktop`，详见[兼容验证记录](docs/compatibility.md)。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 一条完整的工作流程：1. 从侧栏打开“Agent 工作室”，新建 Agent，或复制内置预设。
2. 选择对话模型、系统提示词、插件工具与 Skills。每个插件可选择全部工具或精确子集。
3. 输入消息试运行；手动或自动执行工具，编辑工具结果后继续模型，也可从指定消息重跑。旧运行保留在历史中。
4. 使用保存的 Agent 开始正式对话，或导出 Preset，在另一套宿主中运行。

工具归属来自宿主的实际注册信息。会话开始时保存有效工具范围和插件身份；续接和历史重试保持原快照。插件移除或工具归属变化会明确报告不可用，不会静默授予同名的新工具。

截图来自隔离的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，使用合成数据与本地脚本模型，仅展示界面和操作，不代表真实外部模型的回答质量。
dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 通过对话创建 Agent：在新会话开始前选择“Agent 创建助手”。它依次确认需求、选择可用能力、编写提示词、检查和试跑，用户确认后保存。创建工具只属于该预设，标准模式和其他 Agent 不带这些工具。创建助手的试跑只真实执行只读工具，其余调用记录为未执行；未保存草稿不会出现在工作室列表中。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 它会修改什么：工作室会**停用官方 `tools` 配置行**，换成记录工具注册归属的 `ToolRuntime` 子类。执行、schema 校验、权限和作用域检查沿用官方父类，原 `tools` 行的配置会被继承。同时挂载能力快照服务，并把已保存 Agent 注册成预设。

**其他替换工具提供者或改写同一工具层的插件可能冲突。** 同时使用前核对组合配置。安装、卸载或修改工具提供者配置后重启 Profile。卸载工作室 Bundle 后官方提供者恢复，除非你另有覆盖它的配置。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 数据与卸载：数据使用宿主官方存储后端，默认位于 **`$DSH_HOME/storages`**：

| 数据域 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `workbench_agent_studio` | Agent、修订、试运行、评价、工具回执与提示词草稿 |
| `workbench_agent_studio_capabilities` | 会话能力快照 |
| `workbench_agent_studio_library_migrations` | 显式兼容迁移的回执；无需安装资料库 |

默认工作目录为 `$DSH_HOME/workbench-agent-studio/workspace`。模型、凭据和工具由宿主提供；试运行内容会发送到你选择的模型，工具按宿主授予的权限执行。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-agent-studio
```

卸载后重启 Profile。工作室入口与 API 消失，保存的数据保留，重装后可继续读取；用户文件和会话不会被删除。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 在另一套环境运行导出的 Preset：接收端安装独立 Runtime、实际用到的工具插件，并配置对应模型：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-runtime-1.10.5.tgz
dsh web --patch /path/to/exported-agent.yml
```

导出文件带有宿主级工具注册器、快照服务和 Preset 配置，不需要工作室 Service/UI。不要在每个 Agent 内重复挂载快照服务；移除 Runtime 前先移除依赖它的 Preset 配置。
section: 在另一套环境运行导出的 Preset

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 安装：需要 **Node.js 24+**，以及官方 **DSH Web 0.1.7-rc.2 或 0.2.0-rc.2**。停止目标 Web Profile 后执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-1.13.3.tgz
dsh web
```

上面的命令直接安装 GitHub Release 产物。本版出现在 npm 后，也可按包名 `dsh-workbench-agent-studio@1.13.3` 安装。

安装和启动使用相同的 `DSH_HOME`。完整包内含 Service、UI 和 Runtime；不依赖导航、主题、资料库或文档插件。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 安装：也可从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) 下载预构建 `.tgz`，将文件路径传给 `dsh plugin --profile web add`。GitHub 源码不含 `dist/`，不能把源码下载当作现成安装包。

本版为 **工作室 1.13.3 / runtime 1.10.5**，只声明上述两个精确宿主版本。**不支持 0.2.1-alpha.5**：该版移除了工具 `both` 模式，PTC 行为也有变化。已补充验证官方 macOS Apple Silicon 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2，其他桌面版本仍未验证。桌面安装须使用自带 CLI 和 `--profile desktop`，详见[兼容验证记录](docs/compatibility.md)。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 一条完整的工作流程：1. 从侧栏打开“Agent 工作室”，新建 Agent，或复制内置预设。
2. 选择对话模型、系统提示词、插件工具与 Skills。每个插件可选择全部工具或精确子集。
3. 输入消息试运行；手动或自动执行工具，编辑工具结果后继续模型，也可从指定消息重跑。旧运行保留在历史中。
4. 使用保存的 Agent 开始正式对话，或导出 Preset，在另一套宿主中运行。

工具归属来自宿主的实际注册信息。会话开始时保存有效工具范围和插件身份；续接和历史重试保持原快照。插件移除或工具归属变化会明确报告不可用，不会静默授予同名的新工具。

截图来自隔离的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，使用合成数据与本地脚本模型，仅展示界面和操作，不代表真实外部模型的回答质量。
dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 通过对话创建 Agent：在新会话开始前选择“Agent 创建助手”。它依次确认需求、选择可用能力、编写提示词、检查和试跑，用户确认后保存。创建工具只属于该预设，标准模式和其他 Agent 不带这些工具。创建助手的试跑只真实执行只读工具，其余调用记录为未执行；未保存草稿不会出现在工作室列表中。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 它会修改什么：工作室会**停用官方 `tools` 配置行**，换成记录工具注册归属的 `ToolRuntime` 子类。执行、schema 校验、权限和作用域检查沿用官方父类，原 `tools` 行的配置会被继承。同时挂载能力快照服务，并把已保存 Agent 注册成预设。

**其他替换工具提供者或改写同一工具层的插件可能冲突。** 同时使用前核对组合配置。安装、卸载或修改工具提供者配置后重启 Profile。卸载工作室 Bundle 后官方提供者恢复，除非你另有覆盖它的配置。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 数据与卸载：数据使用宿主官方存储后端，默认位于 **`$DSH_HOME/storages`**：

| 数据域 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `workbench_agent_studio` | Agent、修订、试运行、评价、工具回执与提示词草稿 |
| `workbench_agent_studio_capabilities` | 会话能力快照 |
| `workbench_agent_studio_library_migrations` | 显式兼容迁移的回执；无需安装资料库 |

默认工作目录为 `$DSH_HOME/workbench-agent-studio/workspace`。模型、凭据和工具由宿主提供；试运行内容会发送到你选择的模型，工具按宿主授予的权限执行。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-agent-studio
```

卸载后重启 Profile。工作室入口与 API 消失，保存的数据保留，重装后可继续读取；用户文件和会话不会被删除。

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · 在另一套环境运行导出的 Preset：接收端安装独立 Runtime、实际用到的工具插件，并配置对应模型：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-runtime-1.10.5.tgz
dsh web --patch /path/to/exported-agent.yml
```

导出文件带有宿主级工具注册器、快照服务和 Preset 配置，不需要工作室 Service/UI。不要在每个 Agent 内重复挂载快照服务；移除 Runtime 前先移除依赖它的 Preset 配置。
section: 在另一套环境运行导出的 Preset

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · DSH Agent Studio：Build and test Agents visually in DeepSeek Harness Web: bind tools by plugin, edit tool results during trials, preserve session capability snapshots, and export standalone presets. A guided Agent Creator preset helps draft new Agents in conversation.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#install) · [Downloads](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：Requires **Node.js 24+** and **DSH Web 0.1.7-rc.2 or 0.2.0-rc.2**. Stop the target Web profile, then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-1.13.3.tgz
dsh web
```

The command above installs the prebuilt GitHub Release. When this version is available on npm, you can also install `dsh-workbench-agent-studio@1.13.3` by package name.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：Use the same `DSH_HOME` for installation and startup. The application archive includes its service, UI and runtime components; navigation, themes and Library are optional and are not installed by Studio.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：You can also download the prebuilt `.tgz` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/latest) and pass its path to `dsh plugin --profile web add`. Installing a GitHub source checkout is not equivalent: compiled `dist/` files are intentionally not committed.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Install：**Version scope:** Studio **1.13.3**, portable runtime **1.10.5**. Only the two exact DSH versions above are declared compatible. `0.2.1-alpha.5` removes the `both` tool mode and changes PTC behavior; it is not supported by this release. Official macOS Apple Silicon Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 has also passed the [additional desktop checks](docs/compatibility.md); other desktop builds remain unverified. Desktop installation uses its bundled CLI and `--profile desktop`, not the Web profile.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Configure, try, revise：1. Open **Agent Studio** in the sidebar. Create an Agent or copy a built-in preset.
2. Choose a chat model, instructions, plugin tools and Skills. Choose all current tools from a plugin or an explicit subset.
3. Trial-run a message. Run tools manually or automatically, edit their results, then continue or rerun. Previous runs remain available in history.
4. Start a normal conversation with the saved Agent, or export its preset for another installation.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Configure, try, revise：Tool ownership follows the actual host registrations. At session start, Studio stores the effective tool set and plugin identities. Existing sessions and historical retries keep their recorded scope; plugin removal or changed ownership is reported rather than silently granting a replacement tool.

Screenshots use an isolated DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 instance, synthetic data and a local scripted model. They illustrate the interface, not the quality of an external model's answers.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Guided Agent Creator：Choose **Agent 创建助手 / Agent Creator** before starting a conversation. It collects requirements, selects available capabilities, drafts instructions, checks the draft, offers a trial, and saves only after confirmation. Creator tools are scoped to this preset; they are not added to standard mode or unrelated Agents. Creator trials execute read-only tools and record other calls without executing them. Unsaved drafts do not appear in the Studio Agent list.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · What this plugin changes：Studio **disables the official `tools` configuration row** and installs a `ToolRuntime` subclass that records plugin ownership. Tool execution, schema validation, permissions and scope enforcement remain in the official superclass. The original row's configuration is inherited. It also mounts a capability snapshot service and registers saved Agents as presets.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · What this plugin changes：**Other plugins that replace the tool provider or rewrite the same tool layer can conflict.** Check the combined configuration before using them together. Restart the profile after installation, removal or tool-provider configuration changes. Removing the Studio bundle restores the official provider unless another user patch disables it.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：Studio uses official storage domains under the host's configured storage backend (by default **`$DSH_HOME/storages`**):

| Domain | Stored data |
|---|---|
| `workbench_agent_studio` | Agents, revisions, trials, evaluations, tool receipts and prompt drafts |
| `workbench_agent_studio_capabilities` | Session capability snapshots |
| `workbench_agent_studio_library_migrations` | Explicit compatibility-migration receipts; Library is optional |

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：The default working directory is `$DSH_HOME/workbench-agent-studio/workspace`. Models, credentials and tool providers come from your host. Trial content is sent to the model you select; selected tools act with their host permissions.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workbench-agent-studio
```

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Data and removal：Restart the profile after removal. The Studio UI/API are removed; saved data are retained and become available after reinstallation. Removing Studio does not delete user files or sessions. Exported presets still need the standalone runtime below.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Run an exported preset elsewhere：Install the **portable runtime**, the exported Agent's actual tool plugins, and configure its model in the destination host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lucky01222/dsh-workbench-agent-studio/releases/download/v1.13.3/dsh-workbench-agent-studio-runtime-1.10.5.tgz
dsh web --patch /path/to/exported-agent.yml
```

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Run an exported preset elsewhere：The export includes the host-level tool registry and snapshot service plus the preset declaration. Do not mount another snapshot service inside every Agent. The destination does not need Studio Service or UI. Remove exported preset patches before removing their runtime.

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Development and verification：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build
npm run check
npm test

dsh-workbench-agent-studio README · Development and verification：`check` checks JavaScript syntax, not full TypeScript types. The host suites were run against official 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2. Clean Web validation covered plugin binding, a real file-tool call, edited tool results, history, runtime-only preset import, removal and reinstall with data preserved. Scripted-model and in-memory-DOM tests do not establish external-model quality or every desktop/browser configuration.
